user.title: Home Lab Companion
user.description: Home Assistant connects to the Companion, which listens on TCP port 7010. The key is the COMPANION_KEY the Companion was built with.

discovered.title: Home Lab Companion found
discovered.description: The Companion {name} announced itself on the network. Type the COMPANION_KEY it was built with.

error.invalid_key: A key is 32 bytes in base64 (44 characters).
error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered at that host and port, or the Companion is already connected to Home Assistant.
error.invalid_auth: The key was refused, or it is not a Companion.
error.wrong_device: Another Companion answered at that name.

abort.already_configured: This Companion is already configured; its host, port and key were updated.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: What announced itself is not a Companion.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Shows a notification on the Companion. Fails when it is not connected.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Picks the screen: email, urgent-email, deal. Any other kind shows as text only.

urgent.name: Urgent
urgent.description: Urgent notifications show before the others and take the screen from them.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: The most it stays on screen.

title.name: Title
title.description: One line. For the kind email, the number of unread messages.

body.name: Body
body.description: Up to three lines; may be empty.

off_ms.name: Time dimmed until the screen turns off
